This algae is found chiefly in mild temperate climates, especially in sea coasts and saltwater shores, and is best known throughout Endor.

Even in suitable terrain, it remains very hard to find.

To obtain its properties, it is consumed directly.

The algae allows the user to breathe underwater—and only underwater—for about four hours.

Repeated doses can lead to significant dependence.
